name: Car
summary: Ink sketch generic family car in side view facing right, wheels that spin when it drives; for road.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 760 px wide and 300 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the body bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the car faces left

author: krakujs
